Context: Implementation of MACPS to the Cadre of Junior Engineers of CPWD:

## Implementation of MACPS to the Cadre of Junior Engineers of CPWD:  
The orders for keeping hold the implementation of MACPS to the cadre of Junior Engineers/ Assistant Engineers/ Ad hoc Executive Engineers were revoked. - Min. of UD, OM, dated 11-11-2013.
